title: Zephyr: PLI encode/decode
notes: Implemented isolated Zephyr Compact CoT PLI codec and Kconfig/CMake wiring. Codec is bounded/allocation-free, emits/accepts exact 17-byte big-endian wire format, supports subtypes 0x02..0x05, validates latitude +/-90e6, longitude +/-180e6, and course <=35999, preserves full int16 altitude/uint16 speed/team/role ranges, rejects NULL/short/trailing/reserved input, and leaves encode/decode outputs unchanged on every error. Temporary local encoding/decoding also makes overlapping input/output safe. Focused host C test consumes all 8 canonical positive vectors and malformed/boundary cases; strict -Wall/-Wextra/-Werror + UBSan CTest passed 1/1. cppcheck C11 and git diff-check passed. Shared Python Compact CoT suite passed 87/87; Rust canonical vector suite passed 4/4.
